jobs.description: Lead Project Manager India (m/f/x)Wieland-Werke AG I Pune (India), Ulm I Business Unit Thermal Solutions I Ident. Code 2026-0210 I immediatelyUnleash potential.Copper connects the world - in technologies, such as eMobility, energy and data transfer, refrigeration and air conditioning technology, digitalization and the Internet of Things. Based initially at Wieland's headquarters in Ulm, Germany, you will drive the establishment of a completely new heat exchanger manufacturing plant in Pune, India. As the central project lead, you will take responsibility for this strategic greenfield investment – from initial planning and site preparation through construction, start of production and successful ramp-up. You will act as Wieland's key representative throughout the project, bringing together international stakeholders and shaping the future of our Thermal Solutions Business Unit in one of the world's most dynamic markets. This is a unique opportunity to combine entrepreneurial freedom, broad responsibilities and international collaboration while building a new manufacturing operation from the ground up.- Project Leadership: You take overall responsibility for the greenfield investment, driving scope, schedule, budget, quality and risk management from initial site preparation through construction, start of production and successful ramp-up. You establish and manage project governance, including steering committee reporting, milestone tracking and preparation of decision papers for management.- Plant Set-up: You lead the planning and establishment of the new manufacturing facility, covering factory layout, production processes, infrastructure, utilities, equipment procurement, installation and commissioning in close collaboration with our international engineering teams.- Joint Venture & Entity Set-up: Acting as Wieland's key representative on site and central point of contact, you manage the day-to-day relationship with the Indian joint venture partner and drive the establishment of the new legal entity in close cooperation with our Legal, Finance and Tax functions.- International Collaboration: You coordinate closely with our Thermal Solutions manufacturing sites in Italy, the USA and China, including the Manufacturing Engineer based in Italy, as well as corporate functions in Germany.- Supply Chain & Commercial Development: Together with Purchasing and Sales, you establish a reliable local supplier base, support early customer engagement and drive the commercial groundwork for the new Indian operation.- Organization & Team Development: Starting with a small core project team, you build the local organization from the ground up and develop a strong team across production, quality, maintenance, and support functions.- Operational Excellence: You embed Wieland values, production standards and EHS requirements from day one. You lead the start-up and ramp-up towards stable performance in safety, quality, delivery and cost, ensuring a structured handover to the local operational management.Your Potential- Education: You hold a degree in Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Business Engineering or a comparable technical or business-related field. An MBA with a specialization in Project Management is considered an additional qualification.- Professional Experience: You have several years of professional experience in project management, ideally in industrial manufacturing, plant engineering or a comparable technical environment. Experience in heat exchangers, HVAC/R or metal processing is an advantage.- Project Management: You have successfully managed technical projects, such as investment, plant construction, equipment or production projects. Experience with greenfield projects or plant expansions is a plus.- Leadership: You have initial leadership experience, either in a disciplinary role or as a project lead, and are motivated to take on broader entrepreneurial responsibility.- Entrepreneurial Mindset: You are a hands-on, pragmatic all-rounder who enjoys taking ownership across different disciplines. You are comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, navigating uncertainty and getting things done in a dynamic, evolving environment.- International Experience: You have experience working in international environments and are confident collaborating across cultures. Exposure to India, Indian business practices or joint venture structures is an advantage.- Personality: You combine strong organizational and communication skills with resilience, flexibility and a proactive approach. You know how to build trust, bring different stakeholders together and drive decisions – from the construction site to senior management level.- Languages: Fluent English is essential. German and Italian language skills are considered an advantage, as is knowledge of Hindi and Marathi, particularly for communication with local stakeholders in Pune.- Mobility: You are willing to undertake extensive international business travel, particularly between Germany, India, Italy, the USA and China. You are also willing to relocate to Pune, India, for at least three years to lead the implementation, start-up and ramp-up phases of the project.Your Benefits- Entrepreneurial Freedom: Take ownership of a strategic greenfield investment and build a completely new Wieland manufacturing site from the ground up, with significant scope to shape its future.- High Visibility & Responsibility: Work closely with senior management of

jobs.description: #WeAreIn for jobs that impact everyone's life. What if your ideas could change the way the world connects, powers up, or thinks? Act as the central liaison to other verification and methodology teams at Infineon to coordinate strategies and resolve issues centrally- Lead and execute end-to-end verification of IPs and their integration using best-in-class methodologies (e.g., formal verification, AI-assisted testing) to maximize quality while minimizing time and effort- Lead and review the third-party’s verification methodology and execution, from planning through implementation to final sign-off. Drive vendor accountability to close gaps and meet milestone targets, ensuring integration readiness- Actively guide and support the Chip Verification team in verifying the integrated IPs, with a focus on interoperability aspects and improvement of the methodologies in place. Serve as a direct interface to the IP team to accelerate issue resolution- Define automation frameworks and reusability strategies to accelerate the verification of derivative products- Act as a cross-site and cross-team bridge, connecting various engineering disciplines and sites to minimize verification efforts and late findings. Proactively drive the availability and quality of design infeeds through reviews and early engagementYour profileQualifications and skills to help you succeed - Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field- 7+ years in ASIC, SoC, or FPGA functional verification with ownership of complex block, subsystem, or chip-level deliverables- Expert proficiency in SystemVerilog, UVM, object-oriented testbench architecture, constrained-random verification, functional coverage, and assertion-based verification- Ability to translate specifications and microarchitecture into verification plans, environments, tests, checkers, coverage models, and** sign-off evidence**- Excellent** knowledge of English**, both written and spoken; German is a plus- Experience in power-aware verification using UPF- Experience** applying formal verification methodologies and portable stimulus for test development**- Strong debugging skills with a major simulation and debug toolchain and proficiency in Linux development and scripting or programming with Python, Tcl, Bash, C, or C++ for automation- Experience in practical use of AI and development of AI agents- Deep understanding of chip architecture, specifically regarding CPUs, port multiplexing, power management, bus systems and access protection schemes- Proactive participation in concept and design reviews to ensure quality and verifiability, along with a demonstrated commitment to self-improvement and continuous learning - Experience with** RTL design and digital architecture **with practical knowledge of sign-off readiness- Experience with continuous integration flows- Experience with emulation#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. jobs.description: html Expert R&D Automation and Data Management (m/f/d)Become part of a vital chain and contribute to our common goal of making people’s lives better. Octapharma is one of the largest human protein manufacturers in the world, developing and producing medicines sourced from human plasma and human cell lines. We are a privately-owned company, where the warmth of family meets the scale of a global organisation.Octapharma Biopharmaceuticals GmbH with more than 200 employees is a subsidiary of the Octapharma group founded in 1997 and successfully expanding. Our core business is the development of recombinant proteins produced in human cell lines for therapeutic use in humans. We strive for effective treatments with an improved tolerability and convenience for our patients.Join us in shaping our vision to provide new health solutions advancing human life.We are looking for anExpert R&D Automation and Data Management (m/f/d)to join the Automation and Data Management unit within the Research and Development Department at Octapharma Biopharmaceuticals GmbH.The Automation and Data Management unit is responsible for the development, evaluation and long-term maintenance of automation- and data-driven solutions across R&D. The unit supports scientific projects by combining laboratory automation, data management, bioinformatics and scientific computing, and is involved in the work of multiple research units and virtually all projects within the department.The successful candidate will take on a challenging and versatile role with a strong focus on scientific computing, molecular modelling and high-performance computing (HPC). jobs.employer_name: Technische Universität München (TUM),  Forschungs-Neutronenquelle Heinz Maier-Leibnitz ...
jobs.description: Technical University Munich operates the high flux Neutron Source Heinz Maier-Leibnitz (FRM II) located at the scientific campus in Garching, Germany. The neutron source itself, its research instruments as well as the irradiation facilities provide unique possibilities for the scientific and industrial use of neutron beams.TOFTOF is a neutron time-of-flight chopper spectrometer to study dynamic processes in hard and soft condensed matter. The main areas of application are from materials science, soft matter, biological or magnetic systems. After years of successful operation, the instrument will receive a significant technical upgrade in the coming years.For the further development and the operation of the instrument TOFTOF we invite applications for a full-time (40 h/week) scientist position (m/f/d) asInstrument Scientist Toftof (m/f/d) You will be responsible for the scientific oversight of the technical upgrade of the instrument TOFTOF and attend to its technical realisation.Your tasks include:Scientific lead of TOFTOF’s further developments, i.e. of the neutron transport and chopper system. Conceptual design and future development of the secondary spectrometer, including the neutron detectors. Demonstration of its performance for the intended scientific applications.Project lead for the technical realisation of the upgrade work packages at TOFTOFExperimental tests of instrument critical components to validate performanceMethod development in the area of neutron spectroscopyOperation of the instrument and scientific and technical support in user operationPursuit of own scientific projects using neutron spectroscopy methodsYour responsibility is focused on the instrument TOFTOF. In future, your tasks might include further instrumentation projects.PhD in physics, chemistry, materials science, or a related field.Strong background in neutron spectroscopy and hands-on experience with experimental techniques and instrumentation. Experience with polarized neutrons are an asset.Demonstrated ability to conduct instrumentation projects and operate complex scientific setups.Knowledge of scientific programming and data analysis (e.g. Python, C++, MATLAB) is required, experience with ray tracing simulation packages, e.g. McStas, are beneficial.Self-motivated and independent working style combined with the ability to work in an international and interdisciplinary team.Demonstrated ability to conduct independent scientific research and motivation to develop an own scientific research profilePersuasive communication skills and ability to work in a team in an international environment are mandatory. Good oral and written English skills are required, German language skills are an asset.For further information about the position, please contact Wiebke Lohstroh, E-Mail: wiebke.lohstroh@frm2.tum.deThe high safety standard of our facility requires the reliability of the employees according to German nuclear law. Appropriate reliability checks have to be performed for all employees.We offer flexible working hours, 30 days' vacation per year and a company pension plan (VBL). As an employee of FRM II, you can benefit from many other TUM offers, such asTUM's health offersUniversity sportsTUM's internal continuing education and training opportunitiesTUM childcare (subject to availability)Very good accessibility by public transportThe position is remunerated according to TV-L and limited to 3 years. The position is suitable for severely disabled people. Severely disabled applicants will be given preference if they otherwise have essentially the same suitability, qualifications and professional performance. TUM aims to increase the proportion of women. Applications from women are therefore expressly welcomed.
